scientific_integrity: All proposed conclusions refer to one theorem with the same assumptions and a reproducible complete finite-state proof. No independent certification or priority determination is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The all-length theorem is for ordinary minimum zero forcing sets of P_3 square P_n, n>=5. Small n=3,4 are classified separately. The infinite proof uses an explicit finite-state exhaustive certificate; independent mathematical audit has not been performed. An equivalent historical classification under alternative names remains possible.
title: Two stable exchange components for minimum zero forcing on three-row grids
